description: This file defines a class for an email template that notifies users about disabled delegation credentials and guides them to reconnect their calendar and conferencing apps.

classes.name: DelegationCredentialDisabledEmail
classes.description: A class extending BaseEmail that generates an email informing users about disabled delegation credentials and instructions to reconnect their calendar and conferencing apps.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the email with recipient details and app names.

methods.name: getNodeMailerPayload
methods.description: Prepares the email payload with subject, recipient, and content.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Generates the HTML content of the email.

methods.name: getTextBody
methods.description: Generates the plain text version of the email content.
